baseline.plan: Read unchanged current owner against the precise proposal/report mechanism; preserve dirty checkout and maintain the scoped baseline identified in this audit.

evidence.note: Individual full-section source/current-owner audit, exact contract, scoped decision and falsifier.

record.hypothesis: Mechanism. Implement a logical plaintext range reader over a deliberately prepared, independently authenticated segmented source. Use an existing reviewed construction such as Tink AES-GCM-HKDF Streaming, not a new cryptographic scheme. An authorized caller supplies the key and associated-data context. The adapter retrieves and authenticates complete necessary ciphertext segments, then exposes only the requested plaintext ranges to the existing demux/remux path. First experiment. Encrypt a synthetic MP4 through a pinned reference implementation. Validate browser or Wasm adapter output against official/reference vectors and exact plaintext bytes for startup, distant seeks, straddling ranges, and final short segments. Benchmark against sequential processing of the same encrypted object and a plaintext range-reader baseline.
limits: No runtime test executed; read test code is not executed evidence.
Historical environment blocks are not automatically inherited; shared secure-origin prerequisites only establish APIs.
No source scripts executed, production changes, build, default-route promotion or qualification.

excluded_costs: New execution was outside this source-review assignment.
measurement.primary_metric: Segment overfetch/authentication/transfer and bounded plaintext cache through exact seek.
measurement.result: No new measurement. Historical numeric results remain report claims with the stated scope.
measurement.uncertainty: Current-code applicability is not runtime correctness, physical energy, or qualification.
measurement.worthwhile_change: Concrete capability or meaningful eliminated work in the stated workload after all listed preparation and ownership costs; no global percentage threshold.
